verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing does have automations ("customer communications controlled by Stripe Billing automations"), so this axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents versioning, change review, or rollback for those automations. The dated API versioning and upgrade docs cover pinning the API contract, not user-defined automations. Sandboxes give test isolation, not version history or rollback. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
